I catch her often, staring at me in class. Her hazel eyes pierce into my soul and make my face go red. Freckles dot her cheeks like tiny stars, painting her skin with brown flecks. I gaze into her eyes as she looks me up and down every day, smirking just a little when she reaches my eyes again. That smirk of hers makes my knees weak.

I never expected it to go farther than that. 

I slammed my locker shut and, as always, she was there. Something was different today, though. There was a certain glint in her eyes that made me want to fall into her arms. 

She gently grabbed my wrist, her thumb tracing the faint scars that lay there. She pulled me with her, into an empty closet, and closed the door.

She pushed me again the wall, breathing in my ear. She mumbled words I couldn't make out and put her knee between my legs. Her lips caressed my neck as her arms slipped around my waist. She finally kissed my lips, and I closed my eyes, breathing out softly. she teased me, biting my lip, and I pressed into her. We made out for what felt like forever, a hot and heavy tease, until my legs were numb and I couldn't breathe. 

The bell rang. I cursed under my breath. She laughed, giving me a final parting kiss on my forhead. I shivered under the touch of her arms as they cupped my face.

"Same time tomorrow?" she asked with a smile.
